This is an expansion about the point $x=-10,$ so the coefficient of the second-degree term is $\frac{1}{2}{f}^{″}(-10).$ 

In the given equation, we see that the coefficient of the second-degree term is $15.$ So, we have

$$
\frac{1}{2}{f}^{″}(-10)=15\,⟹\,{f}^{″}(-10)=30.
$$
